title: Techdim Debian 13 Hardening Framework & Ephemeral KVM Sandbox (Kether_1)
description: Reproducible six-layer Zero Trust and CIS Benchmark Level 2 hardening framework for Debian 13 (Trixie, Kernel 6.12 LTS) hosts executing autonomous AI agents without breaking unprivileged user namespaces (userns) or eBPF. Includes deployable sysctl, AppArmor 4.x selective userns, default-deny nftables, ordered auditd (-b 8192, -e 2), DNS-over-TLS, OpenSSH 10 configurations, an ephemeral KVM/QCOW2 sandbox lifecycle orchestrator, a privilege-aware typed-JSON 6-layer metrics collector, a 43-control CIS/BeyondCorp auditor, and automated CI tests.
